messages.content: I haven't done the texting verification yet. Is there a cutoff, or can I do it closer to the election?
There's no cutoff. You can get verified for texting any time up to election day, so there's no need to rush it. Once you're verified, you can schedule texts right through the final weekend.
Great, then I'll wait until October to start it. The election is November 3.
That works. Start Campaign verification whenever you're ready in October, and you'll still have time to text voters before November 3.
